Name: Pierre's Reckoning
Author: kinduff
Description:
[size=5][b]Pierre's Reckoning[/b][/size]

Pierre sells your harvest and tells the whole town he grew it himself. The valley has an old rite for that.

This mod adds a night event in town that unlocks a ritual. Complete it, and Pierre spends one night tied to a cross in the square, confessing about the melons. He is back at his counter the next morning, humbler and cheaper.

[size=4][b]How it plays[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*][b]The summons.[/b] Walk into town any night from 7 PM. The Wizard, Caroline and Morris are waiting at the brick ring in the square. They teach you the ritual. The scene plays once and adds a quest to your journal.
[*][b]The offerings.[/b] Candles and a chalk star now mark the ring. Bring 50 Wood, a Joja Cola, and a gold star crop (any fruit, vegetable or flower).
[*][b]The ritual.[/b] Act on the middle of the ring after 8 PM and say yes. The offerings are taken, a cross rises, and Pierre is called to account.
[*][b]Afterwards.[/b] Pierre stays on the cross until sunrise. You can talk to him up there. From the next day he is back in his shop, everything he sells costs 20% less for good, the empty cross stays in the square, and a few villagers have something to say about it for a week.
[/list]
[size=4][b]Good to know[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Pierre is not removed from the game. He misses one evening and returns the next morning. His schedule, shop, heart events and festivals keep working.
[*]He is tied with rope. There is no blood or gore, and the tone is comedy.
[*]Skipping either cutscene leaves your save in the same state as watching it.
[*]Pierre on the cross is built in game from his own sprite, so it follows Pierre retextures.
[*]Works on existing saves. The ritual happens once per save.
[/list]
[size=4][b]Install[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install the latest [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip this mod into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder.
[*]Run the game through SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6, SMAPI 4.0 or later.
[*]Single-player only. Multiplayer is not supported.
[*]The mod places an action tile and a cross on the brick ring in the middle of the town square, adds one event to the town, and adds a price change to Pierre's shop. Mods that rebuild the town square or move the ring may not line up with it.
[*]Text is English only.
[/list]
[size=4][b]Uninstall[/b][/size]

Remove the mod folder. The cross, the quest and the price cut disappear with it.

[size=4][b]Thanks[/b][/size]

Shoutout to [url=https://www.reddit.com/user/pepobebo88]u/pepobebo88[/url] from Reddit.
